The *Sāṭimattiyattheragāthā* is a poetic text belonging to the *Theragāthā* collection of the Pali Canon (designated as Thag 3.10) [SuttaCentral]. It represents the verses attributed to the elder Sāṭimattiya in the group of triads. Textual commentary on this poem is found in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo), which shares five matching passages with the text spanning segments 0.4–3.5 [DharmaNexus]. Modern translations indexed on SuttaCentral include an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato, as well as eight translations into seven other languages [SuttaCentral].

In terms of cross-tradition parallels, SuttaCentral records a curated passage-level parallel to verses 11–20 of the third *Gāndhārī Dharmapada* (G3-Dhp 11–20) [SuttaCentral]. In addition, computational analysis by DharmaNexus identifies cross-language text reuse matches with the Tibetan translation of the Mahāyāna *Ratnamegha-sūtra* (*’Phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po’i mdo*, D0231), aligning segment 2.2 with folio 95a-0 [DharmaNexus].
